For questions that are not bugs, ask on the [OpenCE Discord server](https://discord.gg/9gqcHyr5km) instead.

## What happened

Describe what you expected and what happened. Include steps to reproduce it.

## Environment

- OS and version:
- Python version (`python --version`):
- Blender version:
- GPU model and driver version:
- OpenTool commit:
- Editing-kit version and, for in-game issues, OpenCE version:

## Command and settings

Paste the exact command and the settings JSON, if used. Redact personal paths and other private information from commands, settings and logs.

## Logs and results

Attach `summary.json` from the work folder and paste the console output. Include `blender.log` if it exists. If the bake stopped before a file was created, say which stage failed. For a visual problem, same-view screenshots of tool and OpenTool output can help.

Do not upload editing-kit tags or game assets. Describe the stock level and any edits needed to reproduce the issue instead.
